source: Spec-Bench (github.com/hemingkx/Spec-Bench, Apache-2.0), data/spec_bench/question.jsonl vendored beside this file. The standard speculative-decoding benchmark used by FR-Spec/SpecVocab/EvoSpec.
usage: Single-turn local benches use turns[0] of each question. Calibration ids feed STS fits; validation ids are held out and are the only quotable generalization results. Never move an id between splits.
